item.title: Daily Arthritis Planner: A Free Printable Plan for Pacing Your Day
item.description: A practical UK guide to planning your day with arthritis, using the occupational therapy 3 Ps (pace, plan, prioritise), with a printable daily planner, essentials checklist, end-of-day check and weekly overview on the page.

item.title: 30-Day Arthritis Pain Reduction Challenge: A Printable Daily Plan (UK)
item.description: A gentle, printable 30-day plan of small daily steps to help you manage arthritis pain: movement, strengthening, pacing, sleep, food and mood, built on NHS and NICE advice, with a daily tracker, weekly check-ins and safety guidance.

item.description: A plain-English UK guide to the blood tests used in arthritis: inflammation markers, antibodies, HLA-B27, urate and monitoring tests, what results mean and why no single test diagnoses most arthritis.

item.title: Arthritis Fatigue Recovery Guide: A 4-Week Plan to Rebuild Energy (UK)
item.description: A step-by-step, four-week plan for recovering from a spell of arthritis fatigue: checking for treatable causes, finding your energy baseline, planned rest, pacing, building activity gently, sleep, food, mood and how to handle setbacks.

item.description: No single breakfast treats arthritis, but a good start to the day can give you fibre, protein, calcium and steady energy, and help with medicines that need food. item.description: A practical UK guide to cooking with arthritis: setting up your kitchen, equipment that helps, joint-friendly ways to chop, lift and open packaging, pacing, simple meals and safe batch cooking.

item.description: A practical exercise finder for people with arthritis that works without any app: answer five simple questions, then use decision tables by joint, ability level and goal to choose safe starting exercises, with links to detailed guides, stop rules and when to get help.

item.description: A plain-English UK guide to the Motability Scheme for people with arthritis: the qualifying mobility allowances, the 12-month rule, what the lease includes, the mileage limits for orders from 1 July 2026, Advance Payments, adaptations that help stiff hands, hips and knees, named drivers, grants and what happens if your award changes.

item.description: A plain-English UK guide to MRI scans for joint and back pain: when NICE says they are useful, why many findings are normal with age, what happens on the day and how to understand your report.

item.description: Protein helps maintain the muscles that support and protect your joints.
